title: The Burning Crown
premise: When the border wards of Thornfell collapse and the stars vanish from the sky, runaway apprentice Casper Reyes discovers their late mistress's grimoire holds the key: the king of Aldmere has been bound to a crown that eats memories, and the crown is nearly finished with him. Hunted by the crown's hollow-eyed enforcers and guided by a smuggler's crew who become the family Casper never had, they must reach the capital and unbind the king before his last true memory—and the last star—goes dark. In the end, Casper learns the crown was forged by their own bloodline to imprison a tyrant, and that breaking it means inheriting both its burden and its power. They shatter the crown, restore the stars at the cost of their own memories of Thornfell, and choose to build new ones with the family they found.
about_author: Mirabel Okonkwo is the pen name of a former cartographer who spent years mapping mountain passes before turning to fiction. She writes fantasy about borders, belonging, and the things we inherit whether we want them or not.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Casper Reyes, hiding in a smuggler's waystation after fleeing their mistress's cottage, watches the border wards flare and die as every star in the sky goes dark at once. POV: Casper. Emotional beat: dread mixed with a guilty thrill—the world is ending, but for one night nobody is looking for an apprentice.

chapters.title: What the Grimoire Kept
chapters.summary: Searching their dead mistress's effects, Casper finds a grimoire addressed to them by name, warning that the crown of Aldmere devours memories and that the wards were her work, now broken. POV: Casper. Emotional beat: grief curdling into anger—she knew, and she left them to finish it.

chapters.title: The Hollow Patrol
chapters.summary: Crown enforcers with empty eyes sweep the mountain roads, erasing everyone who remembers the old king. Casper barely escapes with smuggler Sefa Vane's crew, who owe their mistress a debt. POV: alternating Casper and Sefa. Emotional beat: reluctant alliance; trust begins as transaction.

chapters.title: Roads Only Smugglers Know
chapters.summary: The crew travels forgotten paths toward the capital while Casper teaches them ward-craft and learns, for the first time, what it feels like to be part of something. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: warmth—found family forming around a campfire under a starless sky.

chapters.title: The City That Forgot Its Name
chapters.summary: They reach Aldmere's capital, where citizens wear memory-charms and speak of the king in perfect, identical sentences. Casper realizes the crown feeds on whole districts. POV: Casper. Emotional beat: horror at scale; the mission stops being personal and becomes necessary.

chapters.title: The King in the Mirror Room
chapters.summary: Sneaking into the palace, Casper meets King Aldric, who remembers nothing—not even his name—but clings to one image: a hedge-witch who once tried to save him. He was her friend. POV: Casper. Emotional beat: devastating connection; the mistress's story completes itself.

chapters.title: Betrayal on the Salt Stair
chapters.summary: A crew member, offered restoration of erased memories, sells their route to the enforcers. Sefa is captured; Casper escapes with the grimoire torn in half. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: betrayal and guilt—family can wound like no stranger can.

chapters.title: The Forging of the Crown
chapters.summary: The grimoire's hidden pages reveal the truth: Casper's ancestors forged the crown to cage a tyrant, and each generation must renew it—or end it. The enforcers were once bearers who failed. POV: Casper. Emotional beat: inheritance as weight; Casper accepts the choice their blood demands.

chapters.title: Unbinding
chapters.summary: Casper storms the throne room, frees Sefa mid-raid, and begins the unbinding as the crown fights back with Casper's own worst memories. Aldric chooses to help destroy it, giving up his restored past willingly. POV: Casper. Emotional beat: climax—sacrifice freely given breaks what force never could.

chapters.title: New Stars
chapters.summary: The crown shatters; the stars return, though Casper's memories of Thornfell burn away as payment. Standing with Sefa and the crew on the palace steps, Casper finds the loss survivable—there are new stories to be remembered by. POV: Casper. Emotional beat: bittersweet resolution; found family outlasts what was lost.
